Regarding the treatment plan for lateral epicondylitis (tennis elbow), the described physical therapy techniques are generally considered effective and align with current clinical guidelines. Eccentric strengthening exercises for the wrist extensors are a cornerstone of conservative management for this condition, as they help remodel tendon tissue and improve load tolerance. Manual therapy can assist in reducing pain and improving joint mobility, while ice therapy is appropriately used post-exercise to manage acute inflammation and discomfort. This multimodal approach addresses both the mechanical dysfunction and the inflammatory components of the injury.
